source.description: A lively scene on the quays in Cork is today's image from the seldom visited O'Connor Collection. In the meantime some dockers are busy watching the action in the boats below the quay wall! source.originalTitle: The Old City Market (or the City Produce Market?), near Central Avenue and 3rd Street, ca.1900 (CHS-5083)
source.description: The Old City Market (or the City Produce Market?), near Central Avenue and 3rd Street, ca.1900 Photograph of the Old City Market (or the City Produce Market?), near Central Avenue and 3rd Street, ca.1900. Horse-drawn wagons, loaded with crates of food, fill the square (foreground). Numerous more wagons are lined up along the dirt road (upper left). Legible signs include: "Keystone Building", "importers and exporters", "onions [...], apples and bananas, oranges and lemons, green and [...], nuts and honey, chiles and [...], fresh [...]", "Keystone Produce Co., Incorporated", "headquarters, Moneta and Gardena", "Central Rooms", "Marston & Martin, berries, fruits, and produce".
